title: Rewrite traceability Contract paths during archive

declaredIntent.summary: Make the archive transaction atomically migrate exact current-Work-Item Contract references in the registered instruction traceability manifest.

outOfScope: Rewriting immutable archived Contract, Summary, Manifest, verification command, or execution-path evidence
Fuzzy replacement of similar task names, arbitrary active paths, or unrelated JSON strings
Changing no-active status semantics, branch closure behavior, release state, or RFE-ISSUE-082
Repairing historical traceability entries that do not reference the currently archived Contract
Advancing Japanese assessment, documentation alignment, release, or plan cleanup

sources.reason: RFE-ISSUE-080 records repeated stale active Contract references after archive.
Latest sequence 636 evidence records the manual post-archive active-to-archive traceability migration and resulting transient status conflict.
Authoritative archive transaction, path rewrite helper, index/manifest generation, and rollback boundary.
Existing archive E2E, path rewrite, immutable execution evidence, and rollback regressions.
Registered external traceability manifest whose current Work Item Contract path must migrate during archive.

riskAssessment.reason: An external evidence rewrite during archive can leave the repository half-migrated or alter historical strings if it is not exact, atomic, and rollback-bound.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly required this recurring omission to be fixed in the process before later Work Items and authorized continuous execution.

preReviewWarnings: Confirm only the exact current active Contract path is replaced in the registered traceability manifest.
Confirm absent references are a no-op while malformed registered JSON fails before immutable archive completion.
Confirm any later archive/index/manifest failure restores the traceability file byte-for-byte with active evidence.
Confirm the archived Summary records the generated traceability-manifest change and its documentation alignment path remains durable.
Confirm verification command and executionContractPath strings inside immutable Summary evidence remain unchanged.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A1: During archive, every exact occurrence of the current Contract path in docs/reference/remediation-instruction-traceability.json is atomically rewritten to the generated archive Contract path before the immutable Summary and Manifest are finalized.
A2: Similar task names, unrelated active paths, historical archive paths, verification commands, executionContractPath fields, and non-string values remain byte-for-byte or semantically unchanged.
A3: A valid traceability manifest with no current Contract reference is a deterministic no-op; malformed registered JSON fails closed without moving active evidence.

A4: If any later archive transaction step fails, the traceability manifest, active Contract/Summary, archive index, generated status, and partial archive artifacts are restored according to the existing rollback contract.

A5: When a rewrite occurs, the archived Summary changedFiles and documentationAlignment use the durable traceability path, and post-archive check-instruction-traceability plus status consistency do not require a manual path edit.
A6: Red-first focused regressions, archive lifecycle E2E, full quality, archive, committed aggregate PR check, Hosted CI, merge, ai-close-work-item, and branch cleanup all pass before RFE-147 starts.
guidelines: Keep archive migration exact, repository-relative, deterministic, and limited to the registered mutable traceability manifest.
Treat the external traceability rewrite as part of the same atomic archive transaction and restore its exact original bytes on failure.
Do not rewrite immutable execution evidence or historical archive bundles.
Record generated external evidence changes in the archived Summary so reverse ownership remains complete.
Use red-first positive, no-op, malformed-input, lookalike, and rollback regressions before implementation.

intent.problem: The instruction traceability manifest legitimately references an active Contract while a Work Item is executing. ai_archive_work_item moves that Contract and rewrites paths inside the Summary, but it does not migrate the external manifest. Every completed Work Item therefore risks a stale active path; clean-checkout traceability fails until an agent remembers a manual edit, and that post-archive edit also conflicts with the transient no-active status diagnostic. The defect repeated in WI-20 and again in the WI-01 through WI-20 Hosted recovery.
constraints: Modify only exact references to the currently archived Contract in the registered traceability manifest.
Preserve immutable archive and execution evidence and all unrelated manifest values.
Make the rewrite and restoration part of the existing archive transaction rather than a follow-up command.
Do not combine RFE-147 closure state, RFE-082 release facts, or later release work.
intent.rationale: The archive transaction already owns active-to-archive identity, path replacements, Summary regeneration, Manifest digests, index update, and rollback. Extending that exact transaction to one registered mutable traceability manifest removes the memory-dependent post-step while preserving fail-closed evidence integrity.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The registered manifest contains the exact current active Contract path one or more times.
scenarioCoverage.expected: All exact occurrences become the generated archive Contract path and the archived Summary owns the manifest change.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add an archive E2E fixture with duplicate exact references and assert post-archive traceability plus changedFiles.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The manifest contains lookalike, unrelated, historical, non-string, and verification execution values.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Only the exact current Contract path changes; all other values remain unchanged.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a focused recursive rewrite boundary test and preserve existing immutable Summary execution-path assertions.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The registered manifest is valid but does not reference the current Contract.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Archive succeeds without rewriting or adding a false changedFiles claim.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add a no-op archive fixture and compare original manifest bytes.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The registered manifest is malformed before archive mutation.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Archive fails closed before moving active evidence or changing the index.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add malformed JSON fixture and assert active files and index bytes remain.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A later archive step fails after the traceability rewrite.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Rollback restores the manifest byte-for-byte and restores active evidence with no partial Manifest.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inject an index-write or status-generation failure after rewrite and assert complete restoration.
